name: Netmend Quiz
title: AI quiz generator: text, PDF or link to Google Forms, Kahoot and Moodle
desc: Turn any text, PDF, web page or topic into a quiz with answers and explanations. Export to a self-grading Google Form, CSV, Kahoot spreadsheet, Moodle GIFT or a printable test. Free in your browser.
h1: Any text or PDF into a ready quiz
intro: Paste a lesson, drop a PDF or give a link. Netmend Quiz writes multiple-choice and true/false questions with the right answers and short explanations, then exports a self-grading Google Form, a printable test or a Kahoot and Moodle file.
